#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <string.h>

using namespace std;

struct Pair {
    long long first;
    long long second;
    static Pair makePair(long long f, long long s) {
        return {f, s};
    }
};

struct Graph {
    static const int REMOVED_BIT = 0;
    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount = 0;
    vector<int> firstOutbound;
    vector<int> firstInbound;
    vector<int> from;
    vector<int> to;
    vector<long long> weight;
    vector<long long> capacity;
    vector<int> reverseEdge;
    vector<int> flags;
    vector<vector<int>> adj; // adjacency list for outflow edges
    vector<vector<int>> radj; // adjacency list for inflow edges

    Graph(int vCount): vertexCount(vCount) {
        firstOutbound.assign(vCount, -1);
        firstInbound.assign(vCount, -1);
        from.reserve(2 * vCount);
        to.reserve(2 * vCount);
        weight.reserve(2 * vCount);
        capacity.reserve(2 * vCount);
        reverseEdge.reserve(2 * vCount);
        flags.reserve(2 * vCount);
        adj.resize(vCount);
        radj.resize(vCount);
    }

    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, long long w, long long cap, int rev=-1) {
        from.push_back(fromID);
        to.push_back(toID);
        weight.push_back(w);
        capacity.push_back(cap);
        reverseEdge.push_back(rev);
        flags.push_back(0);
        int edgeID = edgeCount++;
        adj[fromID].push_back(edgeID);
        radj[toID].push_back(edgeID);
        return edgeID;
    }

    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int f, int t, long long w, long long cap) {
        if (cap == 0) {
            return addEdge(f, t, w, 0);
        } else {
            int lastEdgeCount = edgeCount;
            int revEdge = addEdge(t, f, -w, 0);
            int e1 = addEdge(f, t, w, cap, lastEdgeCount);
            reverseEdge[lastEdgeCount] = e1;
            reverseEdge[e1] = lastEdgeCount;
            return e1;
        }
    }
};

struct MinCostFlow {
    Graph& g;
    int s, t;
    vector<long long> phi;
    vector<long long> dist;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitID;
    bool sparse;

    MinCostFlow(Graph& graph, int source, int sink, bool isSparse): g(graph), s(source), t(sink) {
        int n = g.vertexCount;
        phi.assign(n, LLONG_MAX);
        dist.assign(n, LLONG_MAX);
        lastEdge.assign(n, -1);
        if (isSparse) {
            sparse = true;
            visited.assign(n, 0);
            visitID = 0;
        } else {
            sparse = false;
            visited.assign(n, 0);
        }
        if (hasNegativeEdges()) {
            fordBellman();
        }
    }

    bool hasNegativeEdges() {
        // In this code, negative edges are considered if weights are negative
        // For simplicity, assume no negative weight edges for now
        return false;
    }

    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[s] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQueue(g.vertexCount, false);
        vector<int> queue(g.vertexCount + 1);
        int head = 0, end = 1;
        queue[0] = s;
        inQueue[s] = true;

        int maxSteps = 2 * g.vertexCount * g.vertexCount;
        int stepCount = 0;

        while (head != end) {
            int u = queue[head++];
            if (head == queue.size()) head = 0;
            inQueue[u] = false;
            for (auto& edgeID : g.adj[u]) {
                long long totalCost = phi[u] + g.weight[edgeID];
                int v = g.to[edgeID];
                if (g.capacity[edgeID] != 0 && phi[v] > totalCost) {
                    phi[v] = totalCost;
                    if (!inQueue[v]) {
                        queue[end++] = v;
                        inQueue[v] = true;
                        if (end == queue.size()) end = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) {
                throw invalid_argument("Graph contains negative cycle");
            }
        }
    }

    Pair minCostMaxFlow(long long maxFlow) {
        long long totalCost = 0;
        long long totalFlow = 0;
        vector<long long> dist(g.vertexCount);
        vector<int> last(g.vertexCount);
        vector<int> visitedStatus(g.vertexCount, 0);
        int currentVisitID = 0;

        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (sparse) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm(dist, last);
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull(dist, last, visitedStatus, currentVisitID);
            }
            if (last[t] == -1) {
                break;
            }
            for (int i=0; i<g.vertexCount; ++i) {
                if (dist[i] != LLONG_MAX) phi[i] += dist[i];
            }
            long long curFlow = maxFlow;
            long long currentCost = 0;
            int vertex = t;
            while (vertex != s) {
                int edgeID = last[vertex];
                curFlow = min(curFlow, g.capacity[edgeID]);
                currentCost += g.weight[edgeID];
                vertex = g.from[edgeID];
            }
            maxFlow -= curFlow;
            totalCost += currentCost * curFlow;
            totalFlow += curFlow;
            vertex = t;
            while (vertex != s) {
                int edgeID = last[vertex];
                g.capacity[edgeID] -= curFlow;
                g.capacity[g.reverseEdge[edgeID]] += curFlow;
                vertex = g.from[edgeID];
            }
        }
        return Pair::makePair(totalCost, totalFlow);
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithm(vector<long long>& distLocal, vector<int>& last) {
        for (int i=0; i<distLocal.size(); ++i)
            distLocal[i] = LLONG_MAX;
        for (int i=0; i<last.size(); ++i)
            last[i] = -1;

        distLocal[s] = 0;
        priority_queue<pair<long long,int>, vector<pair<long long,int>>, greater<pair<long long,int>>> pq;
        pq.push({0,s});

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto current = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            long long cDist = current.first;
            int u = current.second;
            if (cDist > distLocal[u]) continue;

            for (auto& edgeID : g.adj[u]) {
                if (g.capacity[edgeID] != 0) {
                    int v = g.to[edgeID];
                    long long total = g.weight[edgeID] - phi[v] + phi[u] + distLocal[u];
                    if (distLocal[v] > total) {
                        distLocal[v] = total;
                        last[v] = edgeID;
                        pq.push({total, v});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull(vector<long long>& distLocal, vector<int>& last, vector<int>& visitedStatus, int& currentVisitID) {
        fill(distLocal.begin(), distLocal.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(last.begin(), last.end(), -1);
        currentVisitID++;
        distLocal[s] = 0;

        for (int i=0; i<g.vertexCount; ++i) {
            int u = -1;
            long long minDist = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int j=0; j<g.vertexCount; ++j) {
                if (visitedStatus[j] != currentVisitID && distLocal[j]<minDist) {
                    minDist=distLocal[j];
                    u = j;
                }
            }
            if (u == -1) break;
            visitedStatus[u]=currentVisitID;
            for (auto& edgeID : g.adj[u]) {
                if (g.capacity[edgeID]!=0) {
                    int v = g.to[edgeID];
                    if (visitedStatus[v]!=currentVisitID) {
                        long long total = g.weight[edgeID] - phi[v] + phi[u] + distLocal[u];
                        if (distLocal[v]>total) {
                            distLocal[v]=total;
                            last[v]=edgeID;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n; cin >> n;
    string s; cin >> s;
    vector<int> ugliness(n);
    for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) {
        cin >> ugliness[i];
        ugliness[i] = -ugliness[i]; // invert as in Java code
    }

    int totalVertices = 1 + 26 + n/2 + 1; // as per Java
    Graph graph(totalVertices);

    // Map characters to indices
    auto charToIndex = [](char c) { return c - 'a'; };

    for (char c='a'; c<='z'; ++c) {
        for (int i=0; i<n/2; ++i) {
            int cost = 0;
            if (c == s[i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[i]);
            }
            if (c == s[n-1-i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[n-1-i]);
            }
            int fromID = 1 + charToIndex(c);
            int toID = 1 + 26 + i;
            graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(fromID, toID, cost, 1);
        }
    }

    vector<int> occurs(128, 0);
    for (char ch : s) occurs[ch]++;
    for (char c='a'; c<='z'; ++c) {
        int fromID = 0;
        int toID = 1 + (c - 'a');
        graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(fromID, toID, 0, occurs[c]);
    }

    int half = n / 2;
    int midNode = 1 + 26 + half;
    for (int i=0; i<half; ++i) {
        int fromID = 1 + 26 + i;
        int toID = midNode;
        graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(fromID, toID, 0, 2);
    }

    MinCostFlow mcf(graph, 0, midNode, true);
    Pair result = mcf.minCostMaxFlow(n);
    cout << -result.first << "\n";

    return 0;
}
